The first two seasons were held and organized by the [[Data Force]] clan, represented by {{Player|Skynet|flag=ru}}, {{Player|Maxer|flag=ru}}, and {{Player|Judge|flag=ru}}.

MGL season 1 is a Quake1 (NormalQuake) tournament on dm3, held in the fall-winter of 1998.
MGL season 2 is a Quake2 (OSP MOD) tournament on , held in the spring of 1999.
MGL season 3 is a Quake1 (QW KTpro) tournament, held in the december of 1999.
Moscow League of Players is a Quake tournament that was held in the late 90s. There were three seasons in total. Season 1 - Normal Quake, 4on4, map dm3, timelimit 30 Season 2 - Quake2 Season 3 - QuakeWorld 4x4
